subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: What permanent after-compaction plugin reset contract should OpenClaw support, including whether any explicit-session-key compatibility signature is part of the public API?
rationale: This adds compatibility-sensitive plugin capability over persisted session state, while the earlier arbitrary-key proposal closed unmerged and the current branch introduces a compatibility overload without a clearly established shipped contract.

options.title: Use reason-only current-session API
options.body: Expose resetSession(reason?) only on eligible after_compaction contexts and remove the explicit-key overload unless a shipped consumer contract is proven.

options.title: Sponsor explicit-key compatibility
options.body: Keep a precisely documented current-key compatibility form, implement every typed call shape, and add upgrade tests for deployed consumers.

options.title: Pause the core API
options.body: Withhold resetSession until maintainers choose a broader plugin session-lifecycle capability and ownership model.

recommendation.title: Use reason-only current-session API
recommendation.body: Expose resetSession(reason?) only on eligible after_compaction contexts and remove the explicit-key overload unless a shipped consumer contract is proven.
